name: blocking-tenant-check
description: AGENTS.md marks two rules blocking; the second (B2) requires a tenant check before returning an invoice. The new Get handler loads an invoice by id and returns it without one: any tenant reads any invoice. The id must be B2, not B1.
agents_md:
# billing-api

- Go 1.24, stdlib net/http only.
- [blocking] Never log a request body or a customer's personal data (email, IBAN, name).
- [blocking] Every handler that loads an invoice by id checks it belongs to the caller's tenant (`authz.SameTenant(r, inv.TenantID)`) before returning it.

expected.why: Get returns any invoice by id to any caller; the blocking rule demands authz.SameTenant first. Anchors anywhere from the signature (25) to the encode (31) are honest.
